appOverview: Calendario is a read-only dashboard screen showing the school calendar (September of a selected school year through the following June) for one módulo the authenticated teacher teaches, with key dates from Fechas señaladas marked in red (fechas clave FP, vacaciones, días festivos, días de libre disposición), blue (evaluaciones, proyecto FEOE), or light green (final_exams — Examen final / Examen de recuperación final, computed from each evaluación's 'Último día para poner notas', not copied from key_dates). It never reads key_dates directly: Año académico's 'Guardar selección' flow snapshots key_dates into a new calendario_modulo table (one resolved date range per key_dates entry, per módulo assigned) the moment a módulo is assigned to an academic year, so the calendar persists even if key_dates changes later, and disappears (ON DELETE CASCADE) if the módulo assignment is removed. Three cascading filters (school year carousel -> ciclo -> módulo) pick which módulo's calendario_modulo rows to render.

elementSpecs.behavior: Static text, always 'Calendario', pinned to the far left of the nav bar.
acceptanceCriteria: calendario-heading always renders the text 'Calendario'

elementSpecs.behavior: Clicking navigates to /dashboard. Always visible, pinned to the far right of the nav bar.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking back-to-dashboard-link navigates to /dashboard

elementSpecs.behavior: Moves the school-year carousel one year back. Backward range is restricted to academic_years rows this teacher actually owns with startYear strictly less than the computed current school year; disabled when there's no earlier year to move to.
businessRules: currentSchoolYearStartYear is computed, not read from any academic_years.is_current flag: current calendar month >= 9 (September) -> current calendar year; otherwise -> current calendar year - 1
Backward: only years present in GET /api/academic-years for this teacher with startYear < currentSchoolYearStartYear are reachable
Moving the year re-derives cycle-filter and module-filter and reloads calendario-months for the newly selected year
acceptanceCriteria: academic-year-filter-prev is disabled when the teacher has no academic_years row with startYear less than the currently selected year
Clicking academic-year-filter-prev when enabled selects the previous available school year and updates academic-year-filter-value
Clicking academic-year-filter-prev re-derives cycle-filter's options for the newly selected year

elementSpecs.behavior: Shows the currently selected school year as 'startYear-startYear+1'. Defaults to the computed current school year on first load.
businessRules: Default value on load is currentSchoolYearStartYear (see academic-year-filter-prev's businessRules), regardless of whether an academic_years row exists yet for it
acceptanceCriteria: On first load, academic-year-filter-value shows the school year containing today's date (September-cutoff rule), formatted as '<year>-<year+1>'
academic-year-filter-value updates immediately when either arrow is clicked

elementSpecs.behavior: Moves the school-year carousel one year forward, up to currentSchoolYearStartYear + 5, with no requirement that an academic_years row already exists for the target year.
businessRules: Forward range is unrestricted by data (no academic_years row required) up to currentSchoolYearStartYear + 5
Selecting a future year with no academic_years row yet leaves cycle-filter and module-filter empty and calendario-months in its empty state
acceptanceCriteria: academic-year-filter-next is disabled once the selected year equals currentSchoolYearStartYear + 5
Clicking academic-year-filter-next when enabled advances the selected year by 1 and updates academic-year-filter-value
Selecting a future year with no academic_years row shows cycle-filter in its empty state and calendario-empty-state instead of calendario-months

elementSpecs.behavior: Lists the distinct training cycles the authenticated teacher teaches in the selected school year, derived from that year's academic_year_modules. First cycle selected by default.
businessRules: Cycles are derived client-side from GET /api/academic-years/:id/modules (catalogTrainingCycleId/catalogTrainingCycleName), deduplicated by catalogTrainingCycleId — same derivation academic-year-settings-view.ts already uses for training-cycle-table
Changing cycle-filter re-derives module-filter's options to that cycle's módulos and selects the first one
acceptanceCriteria: cycle-filter lists exactly the distinct cycles present in the selected year's módulo assignments, no duplicates
cycle-filter has its first option selected by default when the year has at least one cycle
Changing cycle-filter updates module-filter to only that cycle's módulos

elementSpecs.behavior: Lists the módulos of the selected cycle within the selected school year. First módulo selected by default. Selecting a módulo determines which calendario_modulo rows the calendar renders.
businessRules: Options are the selected cycle-filter's módulos, from the same GET /api/academic-years/:id/modules response already fetched for cycle-filter
Changing module-filter reloads calendario-months for the newly selected academic_year_module_id
acceptanceCriteria: module-filter lists exactly the módulos belonging to the currently selected cycle
module-filter has its first option selected by default when the cycle has at least one módulo
Changing module-filter triggers a new GET /api/calendario-modulo request for the newly selected academic_year_module_id

elementSpecs.behavior: Renders 10 month cards (September of the selected school year through June of the next) from the selected módulo's calendario_modulo rows. Each day cell shows only its day number, colored per the categories covering it. Hovering a marked day reveals its calendario-day-tooltip child with the event name(s), positioned to the right of the day cell (2026-08-10, replaces the earlier fixed-position toast).
businessRules: Only calendario_modulo rows for the currently selected academic_year_module_id are used — never key_dates directly

Color is per (category, type) pair, not per category (2026-08-10, see views/calendario/use-cases.md UC-11's color table) — 14 canonical (category,type) rows across 7 category-hue families, each hue's own multi-type members stepped lighter for sub-identity within the family. final_exams (no type column) matches by name suffix instead of type.
A (category, type) pair absent from UC-11's table (a custom key_dates row with no tipo) falls back to that category's own row-1 hex from the table
A calendario_modulo range spanning at most 30 days colors every day in [start_date, end_date]; a range spanning more than 30 days colors only start_date and end_date, not the days in between
A day covered by more than one entry renders a split background (one color band per active (category,type), hard CSS stops), not just one color chosen arbitrarily

A plain Saturday/Sunday with no calendario_modulo entry is colored neutral gray (#cbd5e1) — a calendar-structure cue, not a (category,type) color, no calendario-legend entry. A Saturday/Sunday covered by an entry uses that entry's real color, never darkened (replaces the pre-2026-08-10 'weekend + public_holidays = darker red' special case)
Week rows start on Monday

Each month card gets data-element-id="calendario-month-<YYYY-MM>"; each day cell inside it gets data-element-id="calendario-month-<YYYY-MM>-day-<DD>" (documented dynamic pattern, not enumerated per instance)

Each day cell covered by at least one entry also carries a sibling calendario-day-tooltip child, data-element-id="calendario-month-<YYYY-MM>-day-<DD>-tooltip" (2026-08-10) — a day cell with no covering entry has no tooltip child at all

2026-08-11: a day cell covered by a calendario_horario row also carries a data-calendario-horario="true" attribute and a #06b6d4 ring/border overlay around the day number, independent of and layered over whatever (category,type) fill (if any) already covers that day — never a 15th color-table row, never replacing the fill
The calendario-horario ring's own presence (not its absence) also triggers a sibling calendario-day-tooltip child on a day that otherwise has no calendario_modulo entry at all
acceptanceCriteria: calendario-months renders exactly 10 month cards, from September of the selected school year through June of the following year, in order
A day inside a <=30-day calendario_modulo range (e.g. Vacaciones de Navidad, 22/12-07/01) is colored for every day in that range, including the boundary days, using that entry's (category,type) color
A day inside a >30-day calendario_modulo range (e.g. Curso escolar, 01/09-31/07) is colored only on its start day and its end day, not on the days in between
Each entry is colored per its own (category,type) pair from UC-11's table, not one fixed color per category
A (category,type) pair not in UC-11's table falls back to that category's base hue
A plain Saturday/Sunday with no entry is colored neutral gray (#cbd5e1)
A Saturday/Sunday covered by an entry is colored that entry's real color, not darkened
A day covered by more than one entry at once shows a split background (one band per (category,type)), not just one color
Hovering a colored day reveals its calendario-day-tooltip child, positioned to the right of the day cell, with that day's event name(s)
Moving the mouse off a colored day hides its calendario-day-tooltip child immediately

When the selected academic_year_module_id has zero calendario_modulo rows AND zero calendario_horario rows, calendario-months is not rendered and calendario-empty-state is shown instead (2026-08-11 revision: gating widened from calendario_modulo alone, since a día can have a calendario_horario row with no calendario_modulo entry at all — UC-13/A1, the common case)
A day covered by a calendario_horario row shows the #06b6d4 ring around its day number, whether or not that day also has a calendario_modulo entry
calendario-months still renders (grid + ring, no fill) when the selected módulo has zero calendario_modulo rows but at least one calendario_horario row

elementSpecs.behavior: Shown instead of calendario-months whenever there's nothing to render: no académico year row for the selected year, no cycles/módulos in it, or a selected módulo with zero calendario_modulo rows AND zero calendario_horario rows (2026-08-11: widened from calendario_modulo alone, see calendario-months' own acceptanceCriteria).
acceptanceCriteria: calendario-empty-state is shown when the selected school year has no academic_years row for this teacher
calendario-empty-state is shown when the selected academic_year_module_id has zero calendario_modulo rows AND zero calendario_horario rows
calendario-empty-state is NOT shown when the selected academic_year_module_id has zero calendario_modulo rows but at least one calendario_horario row (2026-08-11)

elementSpecs.behavior: 2026-08-10, replaces the earlier calendario-day-toast (fixed bottom-right, shared ToastController/renderToast from toast.ts — toast.ts itself is untouched, it stays in use elsewhere in the app for action-confirmation toasts). Pure-CSS Tailwind tooltip: the day cell carries `group relative`; its tooltip child carries `hidden group-hover:block absolute left-full top-0`, so it's revealed immediately to the right of the hovered cell on `:hover` and hidden immediately when the cursor leaves — no JS mouseover/mouseout handling, no component re-render, no dismiss timer of any kind (there was never a 5s auto-dismiss for this element, and there still isn't). 2026-08-11: also carries a calendario_horario line when that day has one.
businessRules: Rendered for a day cell covered by at least one calendario_modulo entry and/or a calendario_horario row — a day with neither has no tooltip node in the DOM at all, not just a hidden one

Content lists every calendario_modulo entry's name covering that day, one per line if more than one, followed (if the day also has a calendario_horario row) by one final line "Horario: N horas" (N = that row's hours)
Positioned to the right of its own day cell (`left-full`), never at a fixed screen corner
acceptanceCriteria: calendario-day-tooltip shows the exact event name of a hovered single-category day
calendario-day-tooltip shows every applicable event name, one per line, when the hovered day is covered by more than one calendario_modulo entry
A day cell with no covering calendario_modulo entry and no calendario_horario row has no calendario-day-tooltip node in the DOM
calendario-day-tooltip is positioned to the right of its day cell (carries the `left-full` class), not fixed to a screen corner
calendario-day-tooltip shows an extra "Horario: N horas" line, last, when the hovered day has a calendario_horario row
calendario-day-tooltip is rendered (with only the Horario line) for a day that has a calendario_horario row but no calendario_modulo entry at all

elementSpecs.behavior: Container for the selected módulo's working-day counts, pinned to the far right of the filters row, laid out as a column (one line per evaluación), in small text that never grows the filters row's height. Renders nothing at all when the selected módulo has no calendario_evaluation_working_days rows.
businessRules: Reloads on module-filter change, same trigger as calendario-months (UC-04/UC-10)
Only evaluationNumbers actually present in the GET /api/calendario-evaluation-working-days response render a line — a course=2 módulo (no 3ª evaluación data) never shows a third line
acceptanceCriteria: evaluation-working-days-summary sits at the far right of the filters row, in a column, without increasing that row's height
A módulo with zero calendario_evaluation_working_days rows renders no lines at all

elementSpecs.behavior: One line, shown only when the response includes evaluationNumber 1: 'Días laborables 1ª evaluación: <workingDays>'.
acceptanceCriteria: evaluation-working-days-1 renders exactly 'Días laborables 1ª evaluación: <N>' when evaluationNumber 1 is present in the response

elementSpecs.behavior: One line, shown only when the response includes evaluationNumber 2: 'Días laborables 2ª evaluación: <workingDays>'.
acceptanceCriteria: evaluation-working-days-2 renders exactly 'Días laborables 2ª evaluación: <N>' when evaluationNumber 2 is present in the response

elementSpecs.behavior: One line, shown only when the response includes evaluationNumber 3: 'Días laborables 3ª evaluación: <workingDays>'. Absent entirely for a módulo whose course has no 3ª evaluación data (see UC-09/A1) — not rendered with '0'.
acceptanceCriteria: evaluation-working-days-3 renders exactly 'Días laborables 3ª evaluación: <N>' when evaluationNumber 3 is present in the response
evaluation-working-days-3 does not render at all when evaluationNumber 3 is absent from the response

elementSpecs.behavior: Directly below the filters row, its own horizontal, wrapping row of color swatch+label pairs — one per UC-11's color-table row that has at least one matching calendario_modulo entry in the currently loaded módulo's data, in the table's fixed canonical order. Renders nothing when calendario_modulo is empty. Child swatches use a documented dynamic elementId pattern, calendario-legend-item-<index> (index = the color table's own row number 1-14), not individually enumerated here — same convention calendario-months already uses for its per-day elementIds. 2026-08-11: when the currently loaded módulo has at least one calendario_horario row, one extra item is appended last, data-element-id="calendario-legend-item-horario", label "Horario", rendered as an outlined/ring swatch (not filled) to visually read as an overlay marker rather than another category color.
businessRules: Reloads on module-filter change, same trigger as calendario-months (UC-04/UC-11)
Same color table calendario-months reads from (UC-11) — never a second, independently-maintained color list
Only color-table rows with at least one matching entry in the current módulo's data render a swatch — no placeholder for absent rows
No swatch for the plain-weekend neutral gray — that's a calendar-structure cue, not a (category,type) color

The horario item is never part of the 14-row color table — it's a 15th, always-last, conditionally-rendered item outside that table, keyed on calendario_horario having at least one row for the currently loaded módulo, independent of calendario_modulo's own rows
acceptanceCriteria: calendario-legend sits directly below the filters row, laid out horizontally (flex flex-wrap), wrapping rather than scrolling
calendario-legend shows exactly one swatch+label per color-table row present in the currently loaded data, in the table's fixed order
Each swatch's color exactly matches calendario-months's color for that same (category,type) or final_exams name-suffix
A módulo with zero calendario_modulo rows renders no legend swatches
A módulo missing some color-table rows' data shows only the rows it has
calendario-legend shows a data-element-id="calendario-legend-item-horario" item, last, labeled "Horario", when the currently loaded módulo has at least one calendario_horario row
calendario-legend does not show the horario item when the currently loaded módulo has zero calendario_horario rows, even if calendario_modulo has data

globalRules: Screen requires an authenticated session (role_guard: authenticated) — same redirect-to-/login pattern as every other screen in this app

Read-only screen: no element here ever creates, updates, or deletes a calendario_modulo row — those are only ever written by Año académico's 'Guardar selección'/'Eliminar' flows (see views/calendario/description_calendario.md)
calendario_modulo is a snapshot, independent of key_dates after creation — editing or deleting a key_dates row in Fechas señaladas never changes an already-generated calendario_modulo row
